summary: Frontend-only regression of unified PeriodFilter across AccountDetail, Sales, Receipts, Expenses, Reports and Cards. Verified: (a) exactly 4 preset options يومي/شهري/سنوي/مخصص + من/إلى date inputs on every screen with correct testid prefixes (acc-period-*, sales-period-*, rec-period-*, exp-period-*, rep-period-*, cards-period-*); (b) NO *-period-all button anywhere; (c) switching between سنوي and يومي actually changes the number of rows returned (AccountDetail 8->2, Sales 8->1, Receipts/Expenses updated); (d) no JS console errors and no backend 500s observed during navigation. Grep confirmed includeAll usages fully removed from callers (only lives inside PeriodFilter.jsx as unused prop).
critical_code_review_comments: PeriodFilter.jsx still contains the 'all' branch/label and the includeAll prop even though no caller uses them anymore. Consider removing includeAll and PERIOD_LABELS.all to prevent future reintroduction of the الكل button.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Unified PeriodFilter is stable; all 4-option filter screens use consistent testids. If future iterations add new filtered screens, apply the same testidPrefix convention and ensure no *-period-all button leaks in.
